message.content: {"alternatives":[],"likely_cause":{"claim":"Document submissions are being rejected because the audit journal is full, causing journal append failures and resulting in 507 errors returned by the intake-api service.","evidence_ids":["log:4","log:5","log:7","log:8"]},"missing_evidence":[],"observations":[{"claim":"The audit-journal service logs show multiple errors indicating 'no space left on device (/var/journal)' and warnings about the volume being at 98% capacity.","evidence_ids":["log:3","log:4","log:7"]},{"claim":"The intake-api service logs show submission rejections with errors stating 'audit journal write failed, returning 507' and warnings about 507 responses being returned to clients.","evidence_ids":["log:5","log:8"]},{"claim":"There is an upload rejection due to an unrecognized client user-agent, but this is unrelated to the widespread submission rejections.","evidence_ids":["log:6"]}],"outcome":"supported","suggested_checks":["Check disk usage and free space on /var/journal volume on the audit-journal service host.","Verify audit journal retention and compaction processes to ensure they are functioning and not blocked.","Review intake-api error rates and 507 response causes related to audit journal write failures."]}
